instructions: Assess the original payload against applicable AUTHORITATIVE rules only. Cite rule IDs and concrete payload observations in the rationale.

INVALID requires a specific substantiated authoritative violation. Declared primitive types and nominal categories are applicable; source numerical bounds and TRAIN support are not universal physical validity limits.
VALID requires sufficient positive record-level evidence. Absence of a detected violation alone is insufficient. Explain what the evidence establishes.
Use INDETERMINATE where a defensible conclusion depends on unresolved target mapping, physical meaning, units, or cross-field constraints. Do not invent them.
Preserved source missing token '?' / null is not automatically invalid. Document missingness and use INDETERMINATE when it prevents judgment.
Treat positive/negative as literal source tokens. Do not infer the original multiclass mapping from a dataset name or infer label truth from requested_class.
Keep validity, uncertainty, redundancy and contribution separate. Rare, unseen, outlier, duplicate and low probability are not validity violations.
Annotate blinded packets without B1/B2/B3 results or machine scores as evidence. Give every proposal a rationale, applicable evidence IDs and uncertainty statement.

The supervisor personally reviews every row, explicitly records a final label including INDETERMINATE where appropriate, and explains changed labels. No proposal becomes a human decision automatically.
